at-0006.title: Check idempotency_key before validating state
at-0006.content: Every money-moving or balance-changing operation (refunds, credits, payment/invoice changes) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first: scan `ledgerly.audit.events(<event_type>)` for a matching `idempotency_key` and return the original record without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call.
